rules.rule: Every canonical Action mode must expose conformance_result with PASS, UNRESOLVED, or FAIL semantics.
A mode MUST NOT silently change the meaning of PASS, UNRESOLVED, or FAIL within the same profile/mode version.
A breaking semantic change requires a new profile version and, when Action invocation meaning changes, a new mode name or explicitly versioned mode.
Deprecated modes remain explicitly listed during their support window and MUST NOT be repurposed for incompatible semantics.
New optional fields or outputs may be additive only when existing callers that ignore them retain the same result semantics.
Historical durable reports remain interpretable against the pinned profile/vector revision and are never retroactively upgraded to a stronger evidence claim.

consumer_guidance.current_release_channel: commit-pinned candidate; no stable conformance release tag is claimed yet
consumer_guidance.breaking_change_policy: new version/mode; no silent semantic rewrite

nonclaims: This policy does not claim the conformance surface is stable or widely adopted.
A candidate compatibility contract is not a substitute for unrelated consumer evidence.
